name: Black Projects
description: Project management in your vault: Gantt charts, boards, tables, a KPI dashboard, programmes grouping projects, project templates charted by their links alone, recolourable ticket types and document states, a mailbox per project with a reading pane and attachments, Outlook messages dropped in as tickets, meetings with their own kinds and hours, zones telling one project when another is about to cross it, phases, collections gathering chosen tasks across projects, a versioned document library per project, and a requirements library with multilingual wordings, never-reused identifiers translations that say when they have fallen behind and can be drafted by an OpenAI-compatible model, with every figure checked against the source. French interface, working-day scheduling, typed dependencies and working recurring tasks.
author: Black Room Technologies (fork of dotpm, by Stepan Kropachev)
